lesson: 7th Grade Science · Day 2 — Electron Shells & Element Families
title: Electron Shells & Element Families

question_prompts.Q1: Sodium (Na) has atomic number 11 and is in Period 3. What does Period 3 tell you about sodium's electron structure?
question_prompts.Q2: Shell 1 holds max 2 electrons and Shell 2 holds max 8. How many total electrons before needing a 3rd shell?
question_prompts.Q3: Chlorine (Cl) is in Group 17. How many valence electrons does chlorine have?
question_prompts.Q4: Li, Na, and K are all in Group 1 and behave similarly. What is the electron-based reason?
question_prompts.Q5: Which BEST explains why alkali metals (Group 1) are so highly reactive?
question_prompts.Q6: Noble gases (Group 18) rarely react. What is the electron-based explanation?
question_prompts.Q7: Moving DOWN Group 1 (Li to Cs), what happens to reactivity and why?
question_prompts.Q8: Why do atoms get LARGER as you move DOWN a group?
